reason: The hypothesis transfers the Ag-based reactive wear protection concept from a specific TiNbZr medium-entropy alloy (P6, P8) to a generic CoCrFeNi-based high-entropy alloy, and proposes a different mechanism (thermally/mechanically driven Ag segregation to grain boundaries and surfaces during sliding) that is not described in the passages, which focus on in-situ oxide nanocomposite formation with Ag nanocrystals. This represents a substantive new element with a stated rationale, though the core idea of using Ag for self-lubrication is inspired by P6/P8.
